_note: What you see: Choose or remove the workspace's mobile logo and home screen icon, give an app its own brand or exclude it from the house style
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Mobiel logo en startschermpictogram van de werkplek kiezen of weghalen, app eigen merk geven of van de huisstijl uitzonderen
2 apps met een eigen merk, 71 van 73 app: 2 apps with their own brand, 71 of 73 apps follow the house style
Mobiel logo en startschermpictogram: Mobile logo and home screen icon
De kopbalk toont het mobiele logo op sch: The header shows the mobile logo on screens narrower than 1024 pixels. A phone shows the home screen icon when someone adds the workspace to its home screen. Without these images Nextcloud uses the logo and the favicon. The favicon in the browser tab does not change.
PNG, JPEG, WebP of SVG zonder script, ho: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG without script, at most 1 MB. In the header on a narrow screen.
Voorbeeld van het startschermpictogram: Preview of the home screen icon
Een vierkante PNG van minstens 120 bij 1: A square PNG of at least 120 by 120 pixels; 180 by 180 is best. At most 1 MB.
Beide afbeeldingen gelden voor de hele w: Both images apply to the whole workspace, whichever token set is active. A brand per app keeps its own small logo.
Geef een app een eigen huisstijl en logo: Give an app its own house style and logo, such as a knowledge base or a participation platform. On that app's pages the brand replaces the house style, for everyone. Other pages stay as they are.
Acties voor Learniq: het merk weghalen: Actions for Learniq: remove the brand
Acties voor Portaliq: het merk weghalen: Actions for Portaliq: remove the brand
Kies op welke apps de huisstijl van them: Choose which apps the thematiq house style applies to. An excluded app draws its pages with the Nextcloud default style, including the top bar on those pages.
16 van 73 apps getoond, 71 van 73 volgen: 16 of 73 apps shown, 71 of 73 follow the house style
Zo ziet iedereen de pagina's van Learniq: This is how everyone sees the Learniq pages. The app's name stays as Nextcloud shows it: the app menu and page titles come from Nextcloud.
Thema per app zet de huisstijl van thema: Theme per app turns the thematiq house style on or off per app. Brand per app chooses which token set and logo an app gets.
Merken en uitgezette apps gaan mee in de: Brands and excluded apps travel in the configuration bundle to test, acceptance and production.
